biotools.summary: MEPFeatX is a MATLAB package designed for automated and comprehensive motor-evoked potential (MEP) feature extraction in transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) studies. It offers a wide range of stimulation paradigms and incorporates analysis coded in R.
